subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: kb/Work PB1182 (wave 1011 A). SR8 'The data item referenced by identifier-1 is the sending operand.' With 13.10.3 SR2 (a constant-name stands only where a format specifies a literal), BindUnstring refuses a constant-name identifier-1 (COBOL1651) while StrUnstrSender keeps substituting the literal at STRING's sender and both verbs' delimiters (the positive golden). The other halves stay witnessed by da4_function_sending_operand.
